create_identity_rigid3array: create an identity Rigid3Array transformation of a given shape using the identity class method
compose_rigid_transforms: compose two Rigid3Array transformations together using the matmul operator to chain rotations and translations
apply_transform_to_point: apply a Rigid3Array rigid transformation to a Vec3Array point and return the transformed point
construct_rigid_from_4x4: construct a Rigid3Array from a homogeneous 4x4 transformation matrix using the from_array4x4 class method
invert_rigid_transform: compute the inverse of a Rigid3Array transformation to undo its rotation and translation
